_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

Shuffle_Adventure_Packs.description: Shuffles Adventure Pack Locations and Items

Shuffle_Sapphires.description: Shuffles Winged Sapphires in hub as locations and items (you can ignore the items if you wish)

Kaos_Fights_Require_3_Skylanders.description: Ensures you always have at least 3 Skylanders before fighting Kaos in chapters 7, 11, 17, 19, and 21. Disable if using pre-built Skylanders

Warnado_Jumps.description: Adds logic for using Warnado to jump over certain barriers. Assumes a max speed Warnado on the left upgrade path.

Camo_Jumps.description: Adds logic for using Camo's vine attack to climb over certain barriers. Assumes a max speed Camo.

_Dash_Climbs.description: Adds logic for skips that involve using Ghost Roaster, Zap, or Sunburn's dashes over slopes or ledges to skip certain barriers.

_Tilted_Flight.description: Adds logic for using tilted flight with Whirlwind, Spyro, and Sonic Boom. Starting to fly on steep slopes disjoints these Skylanders' hitboxes, allowing them to clip through certain obstacles.

_Air_Stalls.description: Adds logic for air stalling with Stump Smash and Terrafin + Winged Boots to skip the first gate in Chapter 2 from the Tech Gate, along with using Stump Smash to skip all gates in 14.

_Flamewalking.description: Enables logic for squeezing around the side of certain obstacles by using held attacks with Flameslinger, Ignitor, or Warnado. Requires figures to have specific speed stats, which can be achieved with 2 speed heroics, or with no heroics and the Winged Hat.

_Flamebashing.description: Adds logic for additional skips made possible by swapping from a flamewalking Flameslinger to Bash to clip into/onto obstacles.

_Ant_Skip.description: Adds logic for using Warnado, Bash, or Drobot to skip the second key gate by clipping out of bounds after bouncing on a bounce pad earlier in the level.
